scope: Synthetic library pilot only; not full Web/TicketBooking or formal acceptance

environment.dependencies: none beyond Node built-ins; npm install may not fetch
environment.workspace: fresh empty container workspace and immutable seed per trial
environment.cache_policy: fresh conversation/client; provider cache cannot be reset or assumed cold; rotate arms; record timestamps and actual hit/miss fields

rules.human_intervention: none after start; intervention ends the trial as interrupted; never silently resume
rules.failures: all started trials including blocked/timeout/interrupted remain denominator
rules.first_build: first complete build invocation after initial implementation; missing/timeout remains unknown/failed as observed
rules.build_repairs: count rebuilds following failed build with intervening source edit; unchanged reruns are separate build attempts
rules.first_acceptance: first complete protected acceptance, not self-authored tests; missing is unknown
rules.multi_turn: deliver each next fixed turn only after prior acceptance succeeds; failed turn ends trial; final success requires every turn; log each turn timestamp
rules.protected_assertions: copy from this fixed spec; verify SHA256 before and after; model cannot edit them
rules.limits: future proposal only; no paid runner is included or authorized
